name: Suzunari Rin
source:
Age: In his middle-20s (exact age unknown)
Hobbies: Designing accessories 
Likes: Everything to do with Kuri

One of [url=https://vndb.org/c50516]Yuu's[/url] co-workers and someone like an older brother to him. His public face is a silver accessory designer who's attained a certain level of popularity, but he claims that that's nothing more than a hobby.
 
Although he dresses like a woman, it's merely his fashion style. He dotes madly on the woman named Kuri who's his partner in both private and work.

[From the Official Artbook]
